title: AI-Powered Telemedicine Platform with Multimodal Diagnostic Fusion
abstract: A telemedicine system combining dermoscopy, audio analysis, and symptom data through multimodal neural network achieving 92% diagnostic concordance.
claims: Multimodal model fusing dermoscopic images, audio, symptoms via cross-attention.
Clinical decision support with ranked differentials and confidence intervals.
Federated learning enabling improvement without sharing patient data.
problem_statement: 2 billion lack specialist diagnostics. Multimodal AI may close the diagnostic gap.
